answers.why: The Gibeonites speak of killing someone within Israel, the nation ruled by David.
Israel is the nation against which the Philistines wage war.
David is called Israel's light because his life sustains the nation.
The Philistine defies Israel during a battle with David's warriors.
David is Israel's sweet psalmist, associating his songs with the nation.
The God of Israel speaks to David about just rule over people.
The Rock of Israel names God as the nation's protector in David's speech.
Israel's men withdraw from the battle against the Philistines.
The LORD's anger burns against Israel, referred to collectively as them.
David is commanded to count Israel and Judah in a census of the people.
Israel identifies the people whom Joab and the commanders set out to count.
Gad identifies tribal territory near Aroer and Jazer on the census route.
Judah identifies the southern tribal territory through which the census officials travel.
Israel comprises eight hundred thousand sword-bearing men in Joab's census report.
Judah's men number five hundred thousand in the census report.
The pestilence strikes Israel and kills seventy thousand people from Dan to Beersheba.
The plague affecting the nation ceases after David offers sacrifices.
